a10.text: 0 complete session(s) of the 3-5 that spec 12.2 asks for; the protocol and kit are ready, no result is estimated

rows.description: The run selector lists invented S3 runs (s3_rl_dqn, including the reserved seeds 1 and 2); choosing one silently shows the S2 run's data under an S3 label.
rows.fix: Run list from /scenarios only, resolved by scenario and seed (D105, D106); no hard-coded run options.

rows.description: The operator view shows S3 results written into the page (S3_DATA) instead of values read from the API; S3 has not been evaluated on seeds 1-10 yet.
rows.fix: Operator card reads /kpi for every registered label (D102, D107); S3 appears only from the Part 8 outputs.

rows.description: The ambulance view shows a fixed countdown ('00:28') that no data supports.
rows.fix: Junction status from /ambulance/next-intersections only; 'ETA destination : non modélisé' (§4.4, D107).

rows.description: The bus view fills missing fields with invented values (a fixed headway, a fixed vehicle id, a next-arrival text) and a 'live telematics' label.
rows.fix: No `b.<field> || <literal>` fallbacks; absent values say 'non disponible' (D107).

rows.description: The student view shows raw LaTeX ('$p_{50}$') and a broken arrow ('ightarrow'): a backslash-r in the template literal became a carriage return.
rows.fix: Plain French labels ('intervalle à 80 %'); no backslash-r escapes in the script (§4.4, D107).

rows.description: The landing map is a browser-side random animation labelled 'S3 RL DQN' and 'SUMO 60 FPS', not data from a simulated run.
rows.fix: The map becomes the EF-21 replay of a run read from /replay (positions, signals, events); no Math.random in the page (D105).

rows.description: The page opens on the map with seven buttons, not on a home screen with one card per user profile (spec 12).
rows.fix: Home screen with the 5 profile cards, Relecture and Opérateur (D102, §4.4).

rows.description: No deep links: the facilitator cannot set the run and the instant of a task, so the start state of each task cannot be reproduced.
rows.fix: Deep links view, scenario, seed, t, kiosk (D106), applied after the run list is built.

rows.description: Labels overstate the data ('en direct', 'certifié', 'Garantie', real-sensor wording) while the data are simulated and the signal program is provisional (ENF-05).
rows.fix: Footer in every view with 'données simulées', the calibration date and 'programme de feux provisoire'; the overstated labels removed (D104, D107).

rows.description: A pedestrian at a crossing other than S with the reduced speed needs 3 clicks (view, crossing, speed), over the ENF-06 limit of 2. T-PMR uses crossing S, so the tests would not show it.
rows.fix: Speed buttons on the Piéton home card and the last choice remembered (§4.4).

rows.description: Views have no loading, unavailable or error state: a slow or failed API call leaves old or empty values on the screen without saying so (spec 12.1).
rows.fix: data-view-state on every view (loading, ok, degraded, stale, unavailable, error), a 4 s fetch timeout and a last-good value with its time (D104).

rows.description: The Streamlit Operator reads docs/evaluation.md directly instead of the API (spec 8.6), so it can show results that the API does not serve.
rows.fix: Operator through traffic_twin.app.client and the /evaluation, /compare, /series and /sensitivity endpoints (D102, D108).
